question: What is the speaker claiming to wish to hear now, and with what qualification?
premises: The speaker wishes to hear now.
The object is the deception of time.
That deception is qualified as auspicious.
inference: The speaker now wishes to hear of the auspicious deception of time.
uncertainties: How deception of time can be auspicious is not explained here.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear of the auspicious deception of time.
